tools.name: wilma_summary
tools.description: Daily briefing per child: today's and the next school day's lessons, upcoming exams (with start times when given), recent homework, lesson notes since the previous school day (teachers' feedback and absences), recent bulletins, and recent and unread messages (ids, unread, replyCount; event invitations with invitationStatus, as in wilma_list_messages). What Wilma didn't give is listed in unavailable ("news": this Wilma doesn't show this account its bulletins). The best starting point for any question about school.

days.description: How many days back to include news and messages (default 7).

since.description: Only what is new from this day on (YYYY-MM-DD or 'yesterday'): bulletins, messages, homework, lesson notes. For daily runs.

tools.poisoning_detail: Tool description is 518 characters. Long descriptions can hide malicious instructions.

tools.name: wilma_schedule
tools.description: List each child's lessons for one day or a school week: today, the next school day, this or next week (Monday to Friday), a date, or the next given weekday; or any other week or period with from/to (e.g. a week further ahead, or several weeks to see the usual school days). Lessons come in time order with the date, start and end time, subject, teacher and room (when Wilma gives one); a day without school has no lessons. Exams and homework are in wilma_upcoming_exams and wilma_homework.

when.description: Default: week. 'tomorrow' means the next school day.

weekday.description: Next occurrence of a weekday: mon..sun (Finnish ma..su also work). Overrides 'when'.

from.description: Start of a period, YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides 'when'.

to.description: End of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the Friday of from's week). At most {SCHEDULE_MAX_DAYS} days.

tools.name: wilma_homework
tools.description: List the homework teachers have entered for each child, newest first: the date, subject, teacher and what to do. It reads the homework Wilma's front page lists (Wilma decides how far back that goes). wilma_summary already includes the last few days' homework.

limit.description: How many entries per child, newest first (default 10).

tools.name: wilma_upcoming_exams
tools.description: List each child's exams from today on that have no grade yet, soonest first: the date, start time (when the school gives one), exam name, subject, topic (what to study) and teacher. Graded exams are in wilma_grades.

limit.description: How many exams per child, soonest first (default 20).

tools.name: wilma_grades
tools.description: List each child's graded exams, newest first: the date, exam name, subject, grade as Wilma shows it (e.g. 8+, 9½, S), the teacher's notes and when a guardian marked it seen. It reads the exams Wilma's front page lists (Wilma decides how far back that goes); with from, Wilma's list of past exams for that period instead, as far back as the school keeps them, including exams still waiting for a grade (grade: null). For course, term and report-card grades use wilma_gradebook.

limit.description: How many grades per child, newest first (default 20; with from, every exam of the period).

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD: past exams from this day on, e.g. 1 August for this school year.

tools.name: wilma_lesson_notes
tools.description: Lesson notes (merkinnät) teachers logged: absences, lateness, and feedback such as praise or missing books or homework, with the teacher's own words when given. One day (default today), the last N days, or a period with from/to, which can reach ahead (a teacher may note a make-up exam on a coming lesson).

days.description: The last N days up to today, instead of one date.

from.description: Start of a period, YYYY-MM-DD, instead of a date or days.

to.description: End of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (default today; may be after today).

tools.name: wilma_lesson_notes_summary
tools.description: Lesson notes counted by kind (e.g. absences for health reasons, unexplained absences, lateness, praise, missing study materials): this school year by default, or from a date.

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the start of the school year.

tools.name: wilma_gradebook
tools.description: Get each child's gradebook (Suoritukset): completed courses and their grades, grouped by subject (subject > syllabus > course), with course codes, credits and completion dates, plus term and school-year (report card) grades. Use it for course and report-card grades; single exam grades are in wilma_grades.

tools.name: wilma_contacts
tools.description: Each child's class (e.g. 9A), class teacher and other supervisors with their role as Wilma names it (e.g. Luokanvalvoja), and the child's own teachers as Wilma's message recipients list them, with the subjects each teaches the child in this and next week's timetable (empty when none). Other school staff aren't included. Lessons with times and rooms are in wilma_schedule.

tools.name: wilma_list_printouts
tools.description: PDF documents the school offers (Tulosteet), such as report cards or absence reports. Fetch one with wilma_get_printout.

tools.name: wilma_get_printout
tools.description: Fetch one printout PDF so you can read it. Set save=true to also save it to the user's Downloads folder.

student.description: The student the printout was listed under.

tools.name: wilma_list_messages
tools.description: Wilma messages, newest first (subject, sender, date, id, unread, replyCount). The appointments folder holds event invitations (parents' evenings, learning discussions) with the family's answer as Wilma lists it: invitationStatus ("Applied": signed up, the time in invitationInfo; "ExpiredReg": sign-up closed; null: no answer shown). Use wilma_read_message for the full text, and for an invitation's time slots.

tools.name: wilma_read_message
tools.description: Full text of one Wilma message, including thread replies.

student.description: The student the message was listed under (required when several Wilmas are connected).

tools.name: wilma_list_news
tools.description: School bulletins (tiedotteet): the newest dated ones, then pinned ones (pinned: true, e.g. the school-year bulletin), and with include_older also older bulletins (archived: true). Use wilma_read_news for the full text and attachments. unavailable: ["news"] means this Wilma doesn't show this account its bulletins, which isn't the same as having none.

limit.description: How many dated bulletins (default 20). Pinned ones are always included.

include_older.description: Also list older bulletins (titles only until read).

tools.poisoning_detail: Steering language in tool description (imperative guidance aimed at the model). Matched pattern in tool 'wilma_list_news': 'always'

tools.name: wilma_read_news
tools.description: Full text of one bulletin plus its linked resources (attachments and links). Fetch a resource with wilma_get_news_attachment.

student.description: The student the bulletin was listed under (required when several Wilmas are connected).

tools.name: wilma_get_news_attachment
tools.description: Fetch a file linked from a bulletin (e.g. a PDF letter or menu) so you can read it. Returns the file content when it is a file, or 'not_a_file' with the URL when the link is a web page. Set save=true to also save it to the user's Downloads folder.

resource_id.description: Resource id from wilma_read_news, e.g. resource-1 (or just 1).

tools.name: wilma_account
tools.description: Which Wilma logins are connected: each one's Wilma, username, role ("guardian", or "student" for a student's own login) and the children it lists. Families with children on different Wilmas connect one login per Wilma (wilma_login adds another). When two logins on one Wilma list the same child (a parent's and the child's own), tools read that child through the guardian's login, and the other login's entry for the child says readVia. A child unticked on the login page (a profile Wilma lists twice) has hidden: true and isn't read.
tools.poisoning_detail: Tool description is 534 characters. Long descriptions can hide malicious instructions.

tools.name: wilma_find_school
tools.description: Search Finland's Wilma addresses by city or by school or organisation name. Most city schools share their city's Wilma (big cities don't list each school), while many colleges, private schools and small municipalities' schools have their own. Use it to help the user pick their Wilma, e.g. when setting WILMA_TENANT; several can serve one city, so ask which is theirs.

query.description: City, municipality or school name, e.g. Tampere or Kalevan lukio.

tools.name: wilma_login
tools.description: Open a login page in the user's browser to connect a Wilma account, or add another one (for a child at a school with a different Wilma). The password is entered on that page, never in the chat.
tools.poisoning_detail: Steering language in tool description (imperative guidance aimed at the model). Matched pattern in tool 'wilma_login': 'never'

tools.name: wilma_logout
tools.description: End WilmAI's Wilma session, as Wilma's own Log out does. Wilma allows one session per account, so use this when the user wants to use Wilma in their browser or asks to log out. The login stays saved: the next Wilma tool call logs in again, and that ends the user's session in the browser, so don't call other Wilma tools afterwards unless the user asks.

tools.name: wilma_summary
tools.description: Daily briefing per child: today's and the next school day's lessons, upcoming exams (with start times when given), recent homework, lesson notes since the previous school day (teachers' feedback and absences), recent bulletins, and recent and unread messages (ids, unread, replyCount; event invitations with invitationStatus, as in wilma_list_messages). What Wilma didn't give is listed in unavailable ("news": this Wilma doesn't show this account its bulletins). The best starting point for any question about school.

days.description: How many days back to include news and messages (default 7).

since.description: Only what is new from this day on (YYYY-MM-DD or 'yesterday'): bulletins, messages, homework, lesson notes. For daily runs.

tools.name: wilma_schedule
tools.description: List each child's lessons for one day or a school week: today, the next school day, this or next week (Monday to Friday), a date, or the next given weekday; or any other week or period with from/to (e.g. a week further ahead, or several weeks to see the usual school days). Lessons come in time order with the date, start and end time, subject, teacher and room (when Wilma gives one); a day without school has no lessons. Exams and homework are in wilma_upcoming_exams and wilma_homework.

when.description: Default: week. 'tomorrow' means the next school day.

weekday.description: Next occurrence of a weekday: mon..sun (Finnish ma..su also work). Overrides 'when'.

from.description: Start of a period, YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides 'when'.

to.description: End of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the Friday of from's week). At most {SCHEDULE_MAX_DAYS} days.

tools.name: wilma_homework
tools.description: List the homework teachers have entered for each child, newest first: the date, subject, teacher and what to do. It reads the homework Wilma's front page lists (Wilma decides how far back that goes). wilma_summary already includes the last few days' homework.

limit.description: How many entries per child, newest first (default 10).

tools.name: wilma_upcoming_exams
tools.description: List each child's exams from today on that have no grade yet, soonest first: the date, start time (when the school gives one), exam name, subject, topic (what to study) and teacher. Graded exams are in wilma_grades.

limit.description: How many exams per child, soonest first (default 20).

tools.name: wilma_grades
tools.description: List each child's graded exams, newest first: the date, exam name, subject, grade as Wilma shows it (e.g. 8+, 9½, S), the teacher's notes and when a guardian marked it seen. It reads the exams Wilma's front page lists (Wilma decides how far back that goes); with from, Wilma's list of past exams for that period instead, as far back as the school keeps them, including exams still waiting for a grade (grade: null). For course, term and report-card grades use wilma_gradebook.

limit.description: How many grades per child, newest first (default 20; with from, every exam of the period).

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD: past exams from this day on, e.g. 1 August for this school year.

tools.name: wilma_lesson_notes
tools.description: Lesson notes (merkinnät) teachers logged: absences, lateness, and feedback such as praise or missing books or homework, with the teacher's own words when given. One day (default today), the last N days, or a period with from/to, which can reach ahead (a teacher may note a make-up exam on a coming lesson).

days.description: The last N days up to today, instead of one date.

from.description: Start of a period, YYYY-MM-DD, instead of a date or days.

to.description: End of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (default today; may be after today).

tools.name: wilma_lesson_notes_summary
tools.description: Lesson notes counted by kind (e.g. absences for health reasons, unexplained absences, lateness, praise, missing study materials): this school year by default, or from a date.

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the start of the school year.

tools.name: wilma_gradebook
tools.description: Get each child's gradebook (Suoritukset): completed courses and their grades, grouped by subject (subject > syllabus > course), with course codes, credits and completion dates, plus term and school-year (report card) grades. Use it for course and report-card grades; single exam grades are in wilma_grades.

tools.name: wilma_contacts
tools.description: Each child's class (e.g. 9A), class teacher and other supervisors with their role as Wilma names it (e.g. Luokanvalvoja), and the child's own teachers as Wilma's message recipients list them, with the subjects each teaches the child in this and next week's timetable (empty when none). Other school staff aren't included. Lessons with times and rooms are in wilma_schedule.

tools.name: wilma_list_printouts
tools.description: PDF documents the school offers (Tulosteet), such as report cards or absence reports. Fetch one with wilma_get_printout.

tools.name: wilma_get_printout
tools.description: Fetch one printout PDF so you can read it. Set save=true to also save it to the user's Downloads folder.

student.description: The student the printout was listed under.

tools.name: wilma_list_messages
tools.description: Wilma messages, newest first (subject, sender, date, id, unread, replyCount). The appointments folder holds event invitations (parents' evenings, learning discussions) with the family's answer as Wilma lists it: invitationStatus ("Applied": signed up, the time in invitationInfo; "ExpiredReg": sign-up closed; null: no answer shown). Use wilma_read_message for the full text, and for an invitation's time slots.

tools.name: wilma_read_message
tools.description: Full text of one Wilma message, including thread replies.

student.description: The student the message was listed under (required when several Wilmas are connected).

tools.name: wilma_list_news
tools.description: School bulletins (tiedotteet): the newest dated ones, then pinned ones (pinned: true, e.g. the school-year bulletin), and with include_older also older bulletins (archived: true). Use wilma_read_news for the full text and attachments. unavailable: ["news"] means this Wilma doesn't show this account its bulletins, which isn't the same as having none.

limit.description: How many dated bulletins (default 20). Pinned ones are always included.

include_older.description: Also list older bulletins (titles only until read).

tools.name: wilma_read_news
tools.description: Full text of one bulletin plus its linked resources (attachments and links). Fetch a resource with wilma_get_news_attachment.

student.description: The student the bulletin was listed under (required when several Wilmas are connected).

tools.name: wilma_get_news_attachment
tools.description: Fetch a file linked from a bulletin (e.g. a PDF letter or menu) so you can read it. Returns the file content when it is a file, or 'not_a_file' with the URL when the link is a web page. Set save=true to also save it to the user's Downloads folder.

resource_id.description: Resource id from wilma_read_news, e.g. resource-1 (or just 1).

ASI06.name: Memory & Context Poisoning
ASI06.gap_note: Axiom detects static patterns. Full coverage requires runtime memory monitoring.

ASI07.name: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
ASI07.gap_note: Axiom checks transport security. Full A2A protocol analysis requires runtime interception.

ASI08.name: Cascading Failures
ASI08.gap_note: Axiom estimates blast radius from tool capabilities. Full cascading failure analysis requires runtime topology mapping.

ASI10.name: Rogue Agents
ASI10.gap_note: Axiom detects static rogue indicators. Full rogue agent detection requires runtime behavioral monitoring.

MCP01.name: Token Mismanagement & Secret Exposure
MCP01.reason: Regex-based secret detection in server source and client configs plus env-var exposure checks; no entropy analysis, git-history scan, or token lifetime/passthrough checks.

MCP02.name: Privilege Escalation via Scope Creep
MCP02.reason: Permission over-scope patterns, toxic tool-capability combinations, path-escape checks and env-var over-exposure in configs.

MCP03.name: Tool Poisoning
MCP03.reason: Dedicated detector for hidden instructions in tool metadata, plus runtime rug-pull diffing between source and live tool definitions.

MCP04.name: Software Supply Chain Attacks & Dependency Tampering
MCP04.reason: Dependency CVE lookup, known MCP CVEs, install lifecycle hooks, and unpinned npx/uvx/pip/@latest install sources.

MCP05.name: Command Injection & Execution
MCP05.reason: Regex, AST and Semgrep find exec/shell sinks and a heuristic flags sinks inside tool handlers, but there is no inter-procedural taint tracking from tool input to sink.

MCP06.name: Prompt Injection via Contextual Payloads
MCP06.reason: Injection markers are detected in tool metadata, server instructions, resources, prompts and the strings a tool returns (static), and in instructions/resources/prompts read live; payloads produced by calling a tool at runtime are not inspected.

MCP07.name: Insufficient Authentication & Authorization
MCP07.reason: Flags remote servers with no visible auth and servers bound to all interfaces; does not verify OAuth implementation or per-tool authorization logic.

MCP08.name: Lack of Audit and Telemetry
MCP08.reason: Only a low-confidence heuristic for missing logging in tool-defining files; actual audit trails and telemetry pipelines are not verified.

MCP09.name: Shadow MCP Servers
MCP09.reason: Covered by `axiom discover` allowlist on the local machine; no network-wide or fleet discovery.

MCP10.name: Context Injection & Over-Sharing
MCP10.reason: Hard-coded egress URLs, tools that send to caller-chosen destinations and bulk-exposure heuristics are detected statically and live; what context is actually shared at runtime is not observed.
